notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create, then reconciled by hand. The three create CONFLICT warnings (func_ov015_02111414 declared int vs void, func_ov015_0211166c taking void* vs char*, Matrix4x3_FromRotationY taking short vs int) are RESOLVED: each function now has exactly one declaration, typed on daObjBk_Botaosi_c*, and the definitions live in this TU. func_ov015_02111414 is void, as its body is; OnAttacked2 reaches it as a tail call that falls off the end of the int-returning override, the same shape as func_ov015_021128e8 in src/game/actors/d_a_obj_bk_lift.cpp.

func_ov015_021114f0 (0x021114f0..0x0211166c) was never enrolled in config/arm9/overlays/ov015/delinks.txt before this promotion. Its legacy shard byte-matched on its own under `#pragma opt_foldconstants off` (build_pin.verify -> (True, '2004/b56')), but no delinks entry named it, so the ROM build took those bytes from the cartridge. This promotion enrolls it for the first time, as part of the TU; tubuild verify byte-matches it with relocation destinations checked.

Pragmas. The legacy shards carried two file-global settings: `opt_foldconstants off` (func_ov015_021114f0) and `opt_propagation off` (InitResources). MEASURED under default deferred codegen: with neither pragma the TU is 10/12 (021114f0 999 words, InitResources 19 words); with both file-wide it loses Behavior (11 words) and 021114f0 (12 words); push/pop brackets do not bind. The TU therefore uses `#pragma defer_codegen off`, is written in ROM-ascending order, and brackets each setting with push/pop around its one member: every declared function MATCH, emission order ROM-ascending.

The out-of-line destructor is the key function and is defined first, which under defer_codegen off emits D1 (0x02111314) then D0 (0x02111360) and a homeless D2 that is deadstripped -- the ov080 daBttBk_c arrangement. OnKicked and OnAttacked2 keep `#pragma long_calls` (positional): the cartridge veneers are the pooled `ldr ip,[pc]; bx ip` absolute tail-call, 0xc bytes each.

InitResources keeps the ground probe as word storage with dBgCh_Gnd's C1/D1 called by hand: a typed dBgCh_Gnd local synthesizes the ctor at its declaration and the dtor at scope exit, and under opt_propagation off that costs the whole body (999 words, 4 wrong relocation destinations, measured).

Sinit fold: src/unnamed/ov015/__sinit_ov015_02112fdc.c is retired; the two resource handles are defined at the end of this TU and mwcc emits __sinit_d_a_obj_bk_botaosi.cpp, the ctor-table word, and the two destructor-registration nodes. Emitted temp names @836/@837 collide with ov063 globals on main and are renamed to @46/@47 through defined_symbol_renames. The handles emit under the data_ov015_* address spellings this TU already declared; the PoleBillboard_* coin rows at the same addresses were stale (a discarded class name) and are dropped.
